entries.what: The legacy domains API operations are sunset: purchase, price check, availability check and transfer info.

source.quote: The Legacy Domains API is now deprecated. If you use the Vercel CLI for domain purchases, pricing, or availability, upgrade to v48.2.8. Sunset date: 2025-11-09.

lookFor: A request to /v4/domains/price, /v4/domains/status, /v5/domains/buy or /v1/domains/<name>/registry on api.vercel.com, or domains.buyDomain, checkDomainPrice, checkDomainStatus or getDomainTransfer on @vercel/sdk. Other /v5/domains paths, which list and inspect domains, are live.
entries.replacement: The Domains Registrar API: GET /v1/registrar/domains/{domain}/price, GET /v1/registrar/domains/{domain}/availability, POST /v1/registrar/domains/{domain}/buy and GET /v1/registrar/domains/{domain}/transfer.
requires: The buy call requires autoRenew, years, expectedPrice and contactInformation in its body, so fetch the price and contact details first.
On @vercel/sdk these are on domainsRegistrar: getDomainPrice, getDomainAvailability, buySingleDomain and getDomainTransferIn.
A repo that runs the Vercel CLI for domain purchases, pricing or availability needs v48.2.8 or later.

entries.what: vercel login no longer takes an email address or the --github, --gitlab, --bitbucket and --oob flags. It uses the OAuth 2.0 device flow.

source.quote: These methods will no longer be supported beginning February 26, 2026, except for the team method (SAML-based login), which remains supported until June 1, 2026.

lookFor: vercel login with --github, --gitlab, --bitbucket or --oob, or with an email address, in a script, a workflow or a Dockerfile. Plain vercel login is live.
entries.replacement: vercel login with no method, which is the OAuth 2.0 device flow.
requires: Remove --github, --gitlab, --bitbucket and --oob, and any email address, from the command.
The device flow needs a person to approve it in a browser, so a script that ran unattended needs another way in. Reading, not on the page: the CLI takes an access token.
